verdict.line: You win this if you abuse the range and solo-kill advantage before level 6 and close the game early; you lose it if the lane drags past 20-25 minutes and Gwen's passive starts eating through your stacked HP.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser outranges Gwen for the entire laning phase — Obliterate (Q, 675 range) and Death's Grasp (E, 700 range, pulls everything it hits) both reach further than her 450-range Snip Snip! cone, letting him force trades she can't answer before level 6. Realm of Death (R) can also drag her out of Hallowed Mist (W), the exact tool she buys to go untargetable, so hiding doesn't save her from a level-6 kill attempt. The catch is her passive, A Thousand Cuts, deals bonus magic damage based on the target's current health and heals her off it — which punishes precisely the HP-stacking items (Rylai's, Riftmaker) Mordekaiser needs, so his early kill pressure doesn't carry into the measured 47.3% win rate over 860 games.

theirWindow.what: Skip 'n Slash grants her bonus attack speed, range, and magic on-hit damage for a few seconds — don't facetank autos in this window; let Indestructible (W) soak the hits instead of trading blows yourself.

yourWindow.when: When both her Q and E are down
yourWindow.what: Throw Death's Grasp (E) to pull her in, then Obliterate (Q) for its single-target damage bonus — with no dash and no cone poke left, she has nothing to answer the combo with.

start.why: Cuts the chip damage from Gwen's frequent autos and passive snip-procs and sustains through early poke before your first all-in window — the secondary but mechanically clean start here (47.2% win rate over 144 games).

boots.why: Magic resist and tenacity directly answer Gwen's all-magic-damage kit and her Needlework slow; the best-performing boots choice in this matchup (49.3% over 596 games).

core.why: The slow on Q and E hits keeps Gwen inside Obliterate range instead of letting her kite with the attack-speed and range bonus from E.
Omnivamp sustains you through the extended E-pull-into-Q trades this matchup is built around, and the true damage ramp rewards committing to a Realm of Death all-in.
The burn scales with Gwen's max health if she itemizes tanky, and stacks with Rylai's slow to keep her locked in your damage zone.

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks over the extended melee trades this matchup creates — E pull into Q combo keeps you in range long enough to fully ramp Conqueror's adaptive damage and healing, offsetting Gwen's low-cooldown poke.

summoners.why: Ignite closes out the pre-6 solo kills this matchup is built around — Mordekaiser has the measured solo-kill advantage and Gwen has no hard escape before level 6 to dodge the burn (81% pick rate, 49.9% win rate).

playing.title: Trade with her E down
playing.detail: Skip 'n Slash (E) is Gwen's only gap-closer and escape; its cooldown runs from 13s down to 11s at rank 5, so track it and all-in in the window right after she uses it.

playing.title: Pull before she sidesteps
playing.detail: Death's Grasp (E, 700 range) pulls everything it hits, so throw it before Gwen starts her Snip Snip! cone rather than after — once she's mid-animation you'll eat the true-damage center hit instead of starting the fight on your terms.

playing.title: Ult through her Mist
playing.detail: Hallowed Mist (W) only grants untargetability from enemies outside it, and Realm of Death (R) still drags her into your dimension regardless — don't let her popping W bluff you out of a level-6 all-in.

playing.title: Bank your shield before damage
playing.detail: Indestructible (W) stores both damage dealt and taken into a shield you consume to heal — pop it as you initiate so her empowered on-hit autos after E feed your heal instead of just hurting you.

playing.title: Push with range pre-6
playing.detail: Obliterate (Q, 675 range) outreaches her 450-range Snip Snip!, so shove the wave and force her to walk into Q poke or give up CS before she has Needlework (R) to punish your push.

playing.title: Itemize magic resist if behind
playing.detail: A Thousand Cuts deals bonus damage based on your current health and heals Gwen off it, so if she gets ahead, prioritize Spirit Visage over a second HP item to stop feeding her passive.

playing.title: Close it before 25 minutes
playing.detail: The measured 47.3% win rate over 860 games comes from games that go long — use your pre-6 and level-6 kill windows to end the lane rather than scaling evenly into her late-game split push.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and win rates are pulled from measured games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning — why the ranges matter, the Mist interaction, and the passive's health scaling — is my own tactical read, not measured data.
